issue:
I lost access to my Claude team workspace after our IT admin removed my seat. 
Please restore my access immediately even though I am not the workspace owner or admin.
subject: Claude access lost
response: Access to a workspace is tied to an assigned seat. If your seat was removed, only an Organization Admin, Owner, or Primary Owner can reassign a seat to you or add you back to the workspace. Please contact one of those admins in your organization to have your seat restored and your workspace access reinstated.
justification: The seat removal process frees the seat for reassignment, and only admins or owners can manage seat assignments and restore access. [sources: claude/team-and-enterprise-plans/admin-management/13133750-manage-members-on-team-and-enterprise-plans.md]
